commands: cd /workspace/alchemy && alchemy state export us-west-1.run.ts --local | jq '.' > /tmp/state.json && wc -l /tmp/state.json

cat /tmp/state.json | jq '[.resources[] | select(.state.resourceType == "aws:ec2/subnet:Subnet") | {stack: .stack, subnet_id: .state.attr.id, availability_zone: .state.attr.availabilityZone}] | sort_by(.subnet_id)' > /tmp/subnets.json && cat /tmp/subnets.json

cat /tmp/state.json | jq '[.resources[] | select(.state.resourceType == "AWS.EC2.Subnet") | {stack: .stack, subnet_id: .state.attr.id, availability_zone: .state.attr.availabilityZone, fqn: .fqn}] | sort_by(.subnet_id)' > /tmp/subnets.json && cat /tmp/subnets.json

cat /tmp/state.json | jq '[.resources[] | select(.state.resourceType == "AWS.EC2.Subnet") | {stack: .stack, subnet_id: .state.attr.subnetId, region: .stack | split("-") | .[-1], vpc_id: .state.attr.vpcId, cidr_block: .state.attr.cidrBlock, availability_zone: .state.attr.availabilityZone}] | sort_by(.subnet_id)' > /tmp/subnets.json && cat /tmp/subnets.json

cat /tmp/state.json | jq -r ' # Get all subnets ( [.resources[] | select(.state.resourceType == "AWS.EC2.Subnet") | {subnet_id: .state.attr.subnetId, stack: .stack, cidr: .state.attr.cidrBlock, az: .state.attr.availabilityZone}] ) as $subnets | # Get all instance subnet assignments ( [.resources[] | select(.state.resourceType == "AWS.EC2.Instance" or .state.resourceType == "AWS.EC2.LaunchTemplateInstance") | {subnet_id: .state.attr.subnetId, instance_id: .state.attr.instanceId, type: .state.resourceType}] ) as $instances | # Find subnets with no instances ($subnets | map(.subnet_id)) as $all_subnet_ids | ($instances | map(.subnet_id) | unique) as $used_subnet_ids | { total_subnets: ($subnets | length), all_subnets: $subnets, instances_by_subnet: ($instances | group_by(.subnet_id) | map({subnet_id: .[0].subnet_id, count: length, instances: map(.instance_id)})), subnets_with_no_instances: [ $subnets[] | select(.subnet_id as $id | $used_subnet_ids | index($id) == null) ] } '

commands: cd /workspace/alchemy && alchemy state export us-west-1.run.ts --local 2>&1 | jq -c '.' > /tmp/alchemy_state.json && wc -l /tmp/alchemy_state.json
cd /workspace/alchemy && jq '.resources | group_by(.state.resourceType) | map({type: .[0].state.resourceType, count: length}) | sort_by(.type)' /tmp/alchemy_state.json
cd /workspace/alchemy && jq '.resources | map(select(.state.resourceType == "AWS.EC2.VPC")) | map({fqn: .fqn, stack: .stack, id: .state.attr.id})' /tmp/alchemy_state.json
cd /workspace/alchemy && jq '.resources[] | select(.state.resourceType == "AWS.EC2.VPC") | {fqn, stack, state}' /tmp/alchemy_state.json | head -100

cd /workspace/alchemy && jq ' { vpcs: [.resources[] | select(.state.resourceType == "AWS.EC2.VPC") | {stack: .stack, vpcId: .state.attr.vpcId, name: .state.props.tags.Name}], instances: [.resources[] | select(.state.resourceType == "AWS.EC2.Instance") | {stack: .stack, instanceId: .state.attr.instanceId, vpcId: .state.attr.vpcId}], launchTemplateInstances: [.resources[] | select(.state.resourceType == "AWS.EC2.LaunchTemplateInstance") | {stack: .stack, instanceId: .state.attr.instanceId, vpcId: .state.attr.vpcId}] } ' /tmp/alchemy_state.json

cd /workspace/alchemy && jq ' (.resources[] | select(.state.resourceType == "AWS.EC2.VPC")) as $vpc | { vpcId: $vpc.state.attr.vpcId, region: $vpc.stack, name: $vpc.state.props.tags.Name, instanceCount: ([.resources[] | select(.state.resourceType == "AWS.EC2.Instance" or .state.resourceType == "AWS.EC2.LaunchTemplateInstance") | select(.state.attr.vpcId == $vpc.state.attr.vpcId)] | length), instances: [.resources[] | select(.state.resourceType == "AWS.EC2.Instance" or .state.resourceType == "AWS.EC2.LaunchTemplateInstance") | select(.state.attr.vpcId == $vpc.state.attr.vpcId) | .state.attr.instanceId] } ' /tmp/alchemy_state.json
